intro: Plan waves to land on one target in one second, in order: the trap clearers first, then the main army, then the loyalty waves. Add a wave from the send-army dialog (set a landing time, then Add to a new plan or to one landing on that target). Each wave lands a thousandth of a second after the one before, so the order holds whoever sends first; each player sends their own.
noWaves: No waves yet: add one from the send-army dialog.

status.late: Too late: it can no longer land in time

sent: Waves sent: they wait at home and leave in time
deleteDescription: Its waves not yet sent are dropped; armies already sent march on.
